sentences.ar: تَرَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الأَصْفَادِ سَرَابِيلُهُمْ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
sentences.en: You will see the criminals that Day, bound together in irons, their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: Explain why you chose what you chose.
parts.answer: The first does not take a waw haaliyah as it a -Mufrad Haal-; the second can take a waw haaliyah as it is a jumla ismiyah that has dhameer raabit but does not begin with it hence it's optional; and the last one does not take a waw haaliyah as it is a jumla with a فعل مضارع مثبت without a قد and has a dhameer raabit (The waw before it is actually for atf and not for haal).

sentences.ar: مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ
sentences.en: No new revelation comes to them from their Lord except that they listen to it playfully, their hearts distracted.

parts.label: a
parts.ask: For each blue-underlined item, tick whether it is حال, and if so tick the applicable واو حالية ruling (منع الواو | جواز الواو | وجوب الواو); if not حال tick ليست حالا.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: Explain why you chose what you chose.
parts.answer:
All three are haal because that is "their" state when "they" receive the revelation.
The first one does not take a waaw haaliyyah because it is a فعل ماضي which comes after إلا.
The second one requires a waaw haaliyyah because it is a jumla ismiyyah beginning with the dhameer raabit.
The third one does not take waaw haaliyah because it is a mufrad haal and not a jumla.
